vat.noWorkspaceHint: Set up a workspace first to configure VAT.
vat.emptyTitle: VAT is not enabled for this workspace yet.
vat.emptyHint: Enable VAT to seed the default tax codes and choose a method and accounting timing.

saldo.title: Net tax rates
saldo.hint: One rate per business activity above 10% of turnover (no fixed cap since 1.1.2025).
saldo.empty: No net tax rate yet. Add at least one.
saldo.noInputDeduction: Under the net tax rate, input tax is not separately reclaimed.

activity.title: Business activities
activity.hintRequired: With more than one approved net tax rate you must book the revenue separately per rate. Assign each activity its revenue accounts.
activity.hintOptional: With a single net tax rate no mapping is needed. It becomes necessary as soon as a second rate is approved.
activity.noAccounts: This chart carries no revenue accounts.
activity.orphan: This rate is no longer approved above. Pick an approved rate or remove the activity.
activity.contested: These accounts are assigned more than once: {accounts}. A revenue account belongs to exactly one activity.

branch.title: What changed?
branch.why: This workspace already holds posted turnover that the current approval governs. The two options produce different figures, so the choice is yours.
branch.correction: The current approval was recorded wrongly
branch.validFromHint: From which day do the new rates apply?
branch.newLastDay: The current approval (from {from}) now runs until {until}. Periods already filed are unchanged.
branch.correctionHint: The open approval is overwritten. Earlier approvals and periods already filed are unchanged.

basis.title: Declaration basis for tax period {period}
basis.hint: Optional: you may declare the whole taxable turnover at the highest approved net tax rate (MWSTV Art. 88 Abs. 6). It simplifies the return and usually increases the tax due.
basis.perActivity: Per activity at its approved rate (Art. 88 Abs. 1)
basis.highestRate: Whole turnover at the highest rate (Art. 88 Abs. 6)
basis.notCarried: The choice applies to this tax period only and is not carried into the next year.

history.title: Approval history
history.hint: Under the net tax rate method no journal line carries a rate. This history is therefore the only evidence of which rates a filed period was computed with.

code.label: Label
code.confirmArchive: Code {code} stops appearing on new documents. Posted lines that already reference it keep resolving, so nothing filed changes. You can reactivate it later.

error.invalidSaldoRate: Rate not on the current ESTV list.
error.rateUnit: Enter basis points as a whole number 0..10000 (810 = 8.1%).
error.invalidActivity: An activity is incomplete or names a rate this approval does not carry.
error.unknownAccount: An assigned revenue account does not exist in this chart.
error.generationFiled: A period this approval governs is already filed. Record the new rates as a new approval and file a correction return for the periods already sent.
error.grantOutOfOrder: A new approval starts after the one it supersedes. Pick a later day, or correct the open approval instead.

vat.needsRegistration: Enable VAT for this workspace first.

explainer.what: Two settings decide which figure ends up in your return: the method (effective or {saldo}) and the accounting basis ({soll} or {ist}).
explainer.default: Enable VAT sets method and accounting basis to effective and accrual, the statutory default. You can change both later; a change only takes effect at the start of a tax period, and you must apply to the ESTV for the net tax rate and for the cash basis.

notLiableState.title: This workspace does not account for VAT.
notLiableState.hint: That is stored as an answer, not as a gap. If your business becomes VAT-liable, enable VAT here; the answer is reversible at any time.

consequence.effektiv: You settle VAT on your turnover at the statutory rate and deduct {vorsteuer} separately.
consequence.saldo: You settle your turnover at a rate the ESTV approved. Input tax is included in it. You must apply for the rate at the ESTV before switching.
consequence.soll: VAT falls due when you issue the invoice, even if it has not been paid yet. This is the statutory default.
consequence.ist: VAT falls due when the payment arrives. You must apply to the ESTV for this accounting basis.

binding.method: A change only takes effect at the start of a {steuerperiode}. You must keep the net tax rate for at least one tax period; after switching to effective you can return at the earliest after three years.
binding.timing: You must keep the chosen accounting basis for at least one tax period.

eligibility.limits: Allowed up to {turnoverLimit} taxable turnover and up to {taxLimit} tax per year. Both must hold. TILL cannot compute the tax per rate before the approval.
eligibility.none: This workspace has no turnover yet.
eligibility.failed: The turnover could not be loaded.

VatSettings.title: VAT settings
VatSettings.body:
Here you decide how this workspace accounts for VAT: method, accounting basis, VAT number and tax codes. Under the net tax rate you also maintain the approved rates and their activities.

Method and accounting basis are binding elections: a change only takes effect at the start of a tax period and partly needs an ESTV approval. What you set here shapes every later return.
